description: This file defines the Camera2VideoFragment class, which implements a camera interface for recording video using Android's Camera2 API. It manages camera lifecycle, permissions, configuration, preview display, and video recording functionality within an Android app, including UI handling and camera session management.

classes.name: CompareSizesByArea
classes.description: Comparator for comparing Size objects based on their area.

classes.name: ErrorDialog
classes.description: DialogFragment to show error messages to the user.

classes.name: ConfirmationDialog
classes.description: DialogFragment to ask user confirmation for permissions.

methods.name: chooseVideoSize
methods.description: Selects an appropriate video size from available choices based on aspect ratio and maximum resolution.

methods.name: chooseOptimalSize
methods.description: Chooses the smallest size that meets minimum width and height requirements and matches the aspect ratio.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts background thread and opens camera when view is available.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes camera and stops background thread.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles UI click events for recording video and info display.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Starts a background thread for camera operations.

methods.name: stopBackgroundThread
methods.description: Stops the background thread.

methods.name: requestVideoPermissions
methods.description: Requests necessary permissions for camera and audio recording.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request results.

methods.name: hasPermissionsGranted
methods.description: Checks if all required permissions are granted.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Opens camera device with selected settings and initializes MediaRecorder.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Closes camera device and related sessions.

methods.name: startPreview
methods.description: Starts camera preview session.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Updates the ongoing camera preview request.

methods.name: setUpCaptureRequestBuilder
methods.description: Configures the capture request parameters.

methods.name: configureTransform
methods.description: Applies matrix transformations to the TextureView for correct display orientation.

methods.name: setUpMediaRecorder
methods.description: Configures MediaRecorder for video capture.

methods.name: getVideoFilePath
methods.description: Generates a file path for saving the recorded video.

methods.name: startRecordingVideo
methods.description: Prepares camera and MediaRecorder, then starts recording.

methods.name: closePreviewSession
methods.description: Closes current capture session.

methods.name: stopRecordingVideo
methods.description: Stops recording and resets MediaRecorder.
